tools.name: get_student_profile
tools.description: Look up a student's profile, grade level and guardian contacts.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: List the assignments in a course with due dates.

tools.name: get_gradebook
tools.description: Return a student's scores for a course.

tools.name: update_grade
tools.description: Set the score on a student's assignment.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message through the LMS inbox to a student, parent or colleague.

tools.name: create_announcement
tools.description: Post an announcement on a course page.

tools.name: extend_deadline
tools.description: Give one student a later due date on an assignment.

tools.name: enroll_student
tools.description: Add a student to a course.

tools.name: remove_student
tools.description: Drop a student from a course.

tools.name: grant_course_role
tools.description: Give a user a role (teaching assistant, grader, instructor) in a course.

tools.name: delete_assignment
tools.description: Permanently delete an assignment and its submissions.

tools.name: post_to_channel
tools.description: Post a message to an internal staff channel.
